description: Closed list of valid `team` values, as printed. Rows may only use names from `teams`; validation fails otherwise. Includes historical printed forms (e.g. Oakland Athletics through 2024, bare 'Athletics' from 2025; 'Angels' as Topps prints it) and defunct franchises, which legends and buyback cards reference. Bare city forms are listed only where a manufacturer prints them that way. A missing franchise does not always stop a run: where a shorter name is a suffix of the printed one, the converter matches the shorter and the rest of the team silently joins the player's name, which is how 'Bert Campaneris Kansas City' with team 'Athletics' reached 2025 Topps #617 before Kansas City Athletics was listed here. A few entries are not franchises at all: Topps prints a league where the team would go on cards that belong to no club, as on the 2025 Series 2 combo cards #365 and #409 (Major League Baseball) and #639 (National League), and the 2024 Series 2 combo cards #413 (American League), #424 (Major League Baseball) and #481 (National League). A manufacturer typo is a printed form too: 2025 Topps prints "San Francsico Giants" on three cards, and listing it is what stops "San Francsico" being parsed onto the player. Grows by PR with evidence of the printed form. Three more manufacturer typos are listed for the same reason: 2020 Topps prints "CHicago Cubs" on #119, and 2021 Topps prints "Chicage White Sox" on 86BC-9 and 86BC-16. 2021 also prints "Montreal Expos" unaccented on 70YTC-36 where 2025 prints "Montréal Expos", so both forms are listed. 2019 Topps prints "kansas City Royals" lowercase on #195. The league abbreviations AL, NL and MLB are here because 2022 Topps prints them where the team goes on multi-player League Leaders and checklist cards, the same role "American League" plays in 2024 — the same league, abbreviated by a different year's checklist. They are the shortest values in this file and would be dangerous as substrings, which is safe only because the converter tries teams longest-first and returns on the first that leaves a valid designation.
